It gives resellers, MSPs, and service providers centralized visibility across their deployments, helping them proactively monitor systems, resolve issues faster, and deliver better service to their customers. Accessible from any web browser, ecMON continuously monitors more than 100 system events and provides real-time notifications on system health and service status . Administrators can view connected systems in a centralized directory, access key configuration and performance information, remotely manage devices, and track IP phone usage, including device models and quantities. ecMON also includes an AI Assistant (AIA) , powered by OpenAI and trained on Epygi documentation.
